steps.title: Which lifetime-efficiency line fits your dyes?
steps.text: Use measured donor-only lifetime and Förster radius, or walk the illustrative pair. Expert mixtures and spectra remain under Advanced.

steps.title: Start with the illustrative pair
steps.text: Press Load example. It resets the mixture to a generic 4 ns, 52 Å Gaussian example; it is not a vendor calibration.

steps.title: Compute the static line
steps.text: Press Add FRET line to compute from the loaded pair and declared distance sweep.

steps.title: Open the expert controls
steps.text: Press Advanced to reveal the existing mixture, sweep and model-editor actions.

steps.title: Inspect the mixture
steps.text: Press Components to open the retained mixture table. Sweep and Model editor remain available from Advanced.

steps.title: Choose how κ² is averaged
steps.text: In the Live model editor, press static κ²: every molecule keeps its own orientation factor, so one distance becomes a spread of rates. Press Add FRET line again and the new line lies below the dynamic-κ² one. Press dynamic κ² to go back.

steps.title: Keep the line
steps.text: Save CSV writes the computed quantities. Push to ndX overlays them when an ndX window is open.
